function setTorchEnable(torch:Model,enabled:boolean)
	local att = torch:FindFirstChild("火3"):FindFirstChild("Attachment")
	for _,eff:ParticleEmitter in ipairs(att:GetChildren()) do
		if eff:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or eff:IsA("PointLight") then

		end
	end
end

local rootFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("火车大劫案")
local folder = script.Parent
local rootModel = folder.Parent
local _wave = 0
local LocalOrder = rootFolder.LocalOrder

local enemysParent = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("车厢战场敌人")
local v_ResetCD = rootFolder.ResetCD
local v_CompleteTimes = rootFolder.CompleteTimes

function updateEnterCharacters()
	local characters:{Model} = game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player)

	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

	local hits = workspace:GetPartsInPart(folder.ZonePart,overlapParams)
	for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
		local character:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
		local index = table.find(characters,character)
		if index then
			table.remove(characters,index)
			if not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnTrainBattleGround) then
				print(character.Name, "进入列车副本")
				character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnTrainBattleGround)
			end
		end
	end

	for _,character in ipairs(characters) do
		if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnTrainBattleGround) then
			print(character.Name, "离开列车副本")
			character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnTrainBattleGround)
		end
	end
	--for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
	--	local character
	--end
end

function tryGetCurrentRoundModel()
	local model = rootModel:FindFirstChild(string.format("车厢%d",_wave))
	return model
end

function trySpawnEnemys()
	local model = tryGetCurrentRoundModel()
	local suc = false
	if model then
		print(string.format("生成 %s 敌人",model.Name))
		local enemyAttFolder = model:FindFirstChild("敌人生成点")
		if enemyAttFolder then
			for _,att in ipairs(enemyAttFolder:GetChildren()) do
				if not att:IsA("Attachment") then continue end
				local enemy:Model = EnemyHelper:Create(tonumber(att.Name))
				if enemy then
					enemy:PivotTo(att.WorldCFrame)
					enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.TrainBattleGroundBandit)
					enemy.Parent = enemysParent

					local humanoid:Humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
					humanoid.Died:Once(function() 
						enemy:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.TrainBattleGroundBandit)
						enemy.Parent = workspace
					end)
					suc = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	return suc
end

function trySpawnBoss()
	local model = tryGetCurrentRoundModel()
	local suc = false
	if model then
		print(string.format("生成 %s Boss",model.Name))
		local bossAtt:Attachment = model:FindFirstChild("Boss")
		if bossAtt then
			-- 不生成Boss先
			local boss = workspace.Prefabs:FindFirstChild("敌人"):FindFirstChild("Mr.Doge"):Clone()
			--local boss = EnemyHelper:Create(215) -- 生成机枪佬
			boss:PivotTo(bossAtt.WorldCFrame)
			boss:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.TrainBattleGroundBandit)
			boss.Parent = enemysParent

			local humanoid:Humanoid = boss:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

			-- 每击杀一次+1000血
			humanoid.MaxHealth += v_CompleteTimes.Value * 1000
			humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth

			humanoid.Died:Once(function() 
				boss:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.TrainBattleGroundBandit)
				boss.Parent = workspace

				-- 掉落奖励
				ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItemsByRandomId(15,boss:GetPivot().Position)

				-- 统计击杀拳击狗
				for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
					DataHelper:AddStats(player,CommonEnum.Stats.KillDoge,1)
				end
			end)
			suc = true
		end
	end

	return suc
end

folder.ZonePart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart: BasePart) 
	local character:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
	if not character then return end
	--print("进入",otherPart.Name)
	local Torso:Part = character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	if otherPart ~= Torso then return end
	updateEnterCharacters()
end)

folder.ZonePart.TouchEnded:Connect(function(otherPart: BasePart) 
	local character:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
	if not character then return end
	--print("离开",otherPart.Name)
	local Torso:Part = character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	if otherPart ~= Torso then return end
	updateEnterCharacters()
end)

game.CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.OnTrainBattleGround):Connect(function(...: any) 
	if _wave == 0 and v_ResetCD.Value <= 0 then
		-- 生成第一波
		_wave += 1
		trySpawnEnemys()
	end
end)

game.CollectionService.TagRemoved:Connect(function(tag: string) 
	if tag == GameEnum.Tag.TrainBattleGroundBandit then
		
		local lastModel = tryGetCurrentRoundModel()
		if lastModel then
			print(string.format("已清空 %s 敌人",lastModel.Name))
			-- 打开当前已清空的车厢的门
			local DoorPart:Part = lastModel:FindFirstChild("DoorPart")
			if DoorPart then
				local ProximityPrompt:ProximityPrompt = DoorPart:FindFirstChild("ProximityPrompt")
				if not ProximityPrompt.Enabled then
					ProximityPrompt.Enabled = true
					ProximityPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(playerWhoTriggered: Player) 
						trySpawnBoss()
						DoorPart:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
			
			-- 生成宝箱
			local tresuresFolder = lastModel:FindFirstChild("宝箱生成点")
			if tresuresFolder then
				for _,att:Attachment in ipairs(tresuresFolder:GetChildren()) do
					GameHelper:CreateTreasureByName(att.Name,att.WorldCFrame,lastModel)
				end
				tresuresFolder:Destroy()
			end
		end
		
		-- 尝试初始化下一节车厢
		_wave += 1
		if tryGetCurrentRoundModel() then
			trySpawnEnemys()
		else
			print("通关火车大劫案")
			_wave = 0
			-- 赋值重置时间
			v_ResetCD.Value = 25*60
			v_CompleteTimes.Value += 1
			
			-- 成就统计
			local players = game.Players:GetPlayers()
			for _,player:Player in ipairs(players) do
				for _,otherPlayer:Player in ipairs(players) do
					if player == otherPlayer then continue end
					if player:IsFriendsWith(otherPlayer.UserId) then
						print(player.DisplayName,"和朋友一起通关火车大劫案成就统计+1")
						DataHelper:AddStats(player,CommonEnum.Stats.TheGreatTrainRobbery,1)
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end	
end)"},{"id":189,"text":"if script:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Prefabs) then return end

function triggetAttack()
	_nextAttackTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + rootModel:FindFirstChild("Config"):FindFirstChild("雪球发射间隔").Value
	--_nextAttackTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 0.5
	
	local startPosition = rootModel.AttackStart.WorldPosition
	local targetCharacter = v_snowballTarget.Value
	local targetPlayer = targetCharacter and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(targetCharacter)
	for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local otherRoot = otherPlayer.Character and otherPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local inRange = false
		if otherRoot then
			local delta = otherRoot.Position - startPosition
			inRange = delta:Dot(delta) <= 120 * 120
		end
		if otherPlayer == targetPlayer or inRange then
			rootModel.SnowballAttackS2C:FireClient(otherPlayer, startPosition, targetCharacter)
		end
	end
end

rootModel.SetInSnowstormC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, inSnowstorm:boolean)

	if not character then return end
	
	if inSnowstorm then

	else
		character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.InSnowstorm)
	end
end)

SnowballHitEnemyC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, enemy:Model,hitPos:Vector3) 
	if not enemy or not enemy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy) then return end
	if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(enemy) then return end
	if enemy:HasTag("SnowballHitCD") then return end

	enemy:AddTag("SnowballHitCD")
	GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(nil,enemy,v_snowballDamage.Value)
	GameHelper:SetNPCIceSlow(nil,enemy)
	GameHelper:KickAss(enemy,hitPos)
	task.wait(1)
	pcall(function() 
		enemy:RemoveTag("SnowballHitCD")
	end)
end)

function checkInSnowstormArea()
	local character = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not character then return end
	
	local op = OverlapParams.new()
	op:AddToFilter(character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
	op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	
	local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(SnowstormTouchPart.CFrame,SnowstormTouchPart.Size,op)

	if #hits > 0 then
		if not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InSnowstorm) then
			SetInSnowstormC2S:FireServer(true)
		end
	else
		if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InSnowstorm) then
			SetInSnowstormC2S:FireServer(false)
		end
	end
end

function checkSnowBallHit(hitPos:Vector3)
	if not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then return end
	
	local character = LocalPlayer.Character
	
	local op = OverlapParams.new()
	op:AddToFilter(character)
	op:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy))
	op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

	local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(hitPos,snowballPrefab.Size.X * 2,op)
	local isHitMyCharacter = false
	local hitEnemys:{Model} = {}
	for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do 
		if hit:IsDescendantOf(character) then
			isHitMyCharacter = true
		end
		local enemy = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
		if enemy and not table.find(hitEnemys,enemy) then
			table.insert(hitEnemys,enemy)
		end
	end
	if isHitMyCharacter then
		--print("中了")
		SnowballHitC2S:FireServer()
		if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InSnowstorm) then
			kickAss(character,hitPos) -- 在暴风雪里，会被击飞
		end
	end
	
	for _,enemy in ipairs(hitEnemys) do
		SnowballHitEnemyC2S:FireServer(enemy,hitPos)
	end
end
